mapper.insert: insert into "chat_record" ( record_id, ai_friend_id, user_id, description, file_addr, is_ai) values( #{recordId}, #{aiFriendId}, #{userId}, #{description}, #{fileAddr}, #{ai})
mapper.select: select record_id, ai_friend_id, user_id, description, file_addr, create_time, is_ai from "chat_record" where (select exists ( select 1 from chat_room where ai_friend_id=#{aiFriendId} and able_chat=true and user_id=#{userId}) )=true order by record_id desc limit #{need} offset #{start}
